name: shutdown-timer
title: Shutdown Timer
description: Schedule power off, reboot or suspend with a countdown you can always cancel.
author: black

commands.name: timer
commands.title: Timer
commands.description: Arm a power off, reboot or suspend on a countdown you can cancel, with warnings before it fires.

preferences.name: dryRun
preferences.label: Notify instead of acting
preferences.title: Dry run
preferences.description: Replace the power action with a desktop notification, to try the timer without shutting down.

preferences.name: earlyMinutes
preferences.title: Early warning
preferences.description: Minutes before the action for the first warning. 0 disables it.

preferences.name: finalSeconds
preferences.title: Final warning
preferences.description: Seconds before the action for the last, urgent warning. 0 disables it.

scripts.test: tsx test/schedule.test.ts && tsx test/state.test.ts && tsx test/systemd.test.ts
